project_name: Sistem Penilaian & Raport Digital SMPN 37 Jakarta
app_type: dashboard / saas_app (internal school tool in Bahasa Indonesia)

theme.primary_archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST + ARCHETYPE 1: ORGANIC & TRUST (Official Education Portal)

visual_enhancers.kktp_indicator: Fixed KKTP threshold = 75. Automatic visual badge & color code (Green for >= 75, Red for < 75).
visual_enhancers.table_style: Dense spreadsheet grid with direct cell inputs, row zebra striping, sticky headers, active focus rings, and paste overlay indicator.
visual_enhancers.badges: Pill shaped for status (Tuntas / Belum Tuntas), high contrast text.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used selectively on sticky navbar (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80).

layouts_and_grids.login_layout: Split hero layout with official school banner image on left and crisp login form on right.
layouts_and_grids.dashboard_layout: Top navigation header + sub-header with Kelas & Mapel selector pill bar, followed by tabbed content (1. Input Grid Excel / Paste, 2. Manual One-by-One, 3. Cetak Raport Wali Kelas, 4. Leger Nilai Class Summary).
layouts_and_grids.spreadsheet_grid: Sticky student info columns (No, NISN, Nama Siswa), direct editable columns (F1, F2, F3, Avg Formatif, S1, S2, S3, Avg Sumatif, Nilai Akhir NA, Status KKTP).
layouts_and_grids.paste_parser_modal: Dedicated Paste-from-Excel modal with instant preview table before applying values into grid.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Micro-scale hover on buttons, active row highlight in grid, subtle border shine on inputs.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Specific property transitions (e.g. transition-colors duration-150, transition-transform duration-200). Never use transition: all.
motion_and_interactions.toast_notifications: Sonner toasts for auto-save feedback, invalid numerical inputs, paste success summary, and download triggers.

school_hero.description: Siswa SMPN 37 Jakarta belajar dan ujian di kelas

classroom_teacher.description: Guru mendampingi siswa di dalam kelas

data_testid_convention.rules: All interactive elements (inputs, select dropdowns, tabs, export buttons, login forms) must feature kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all user-facing text is in official, formal Bahasa Indonesia tailored for SMPN 37 Jakarta.
Provide a pre-seeded set of authentic SMP student data (NISN, Nama Siswa, Kelas 7A/7B/8A/8B/9A, Mata Pelajaran like Matematika, Bahasa Indonesia, IPA, IPS, Bahasa Inggris, PPKn, PJOK, SBK).
Provide dual grade entry mechanisms: 1) Interactive Excel-like spreadsheet table (direct input & paste parser), 2) Manual student-by-student form card with step progress.

Include live automatic grade calculations: Average Formatif = (F1+F2+F3)/3, Average Sumatif = (S1+S2+S3)/3, Nilai Akhir (NA) = (Avg Formatif + Avg Sumatif)/2, KKTP status (>= 75 Tuntas, < 75 Belum Tuntas).
Implement Wali Kelas section with PDF generation (or printable print preview template) for both individual student Raport and class batch Raport.
Implement Excel Leger download functionality using xlsx / sheetjs or downloadable blob for class grade ledger.
Ensure dark mode toggle is available in top navigation bar.
Never use generic centered layouts or unstyled default HTML select boxes; use customized Shadcn primitives or styled components.
